items.title: Jerry Blumberg Interview, 1961-04-15
items.q: The interviewee narrates stories about Bunk Johnson (e.g., 'Bunk one day said that he had just been up to the Apollo Theater...') and describes Bunk's playing style and the crowd's reaction to him, but does not state a personal interaction or professional relationship with Bunk Johnson himself.

ctx.x: You all said something about Dizzy as he was leaving.

Yeah, well, there was a story. Bunk one day said that he had just been up to the Apollo Theater where Dizzy was playing for a week. And he'd been listening to these beboppers. And he said that he asked Dizzy to define, if he could define his music. And he said Dizzy said he couldn't define his music. And so to this Bunk says, how can a man play music that he can't define? Of course, looking back on it, nobody asked Bunk if he could define his music. But it was kind of funny.
Do you remember any other little things like that that Bunk played that were outstanding that didn't come through the records?
